key_hash.description: Every persisted API-key hash resolved from an active API-key row MUST already be exactly 64 lowercase ASCII hexadecimal characters. Missing, malformed, non-string, uppercase, whitespace-padded, or alternate values MUST fail closed immediately after the key row lock and before key activity evaluation, replay or delivery response emission, persistence mutation, or COMMIT; providers MUST NOT lowercase, normalize, trim, coerce, infer, or disclose persisted key hashes.
